answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the oasis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the garden of the next round. By the quill of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
